subject: Re: Deployment mode & HIPAA requirements

Date: Fri, 8 May 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment mode & HIPAA requirements

Thanks for the time today, Amy — quick recap and next steps from our discovery call:

Summary:
- Use case: Elara will run PHI-containing clinical ingestion and real-time summarization for care coordination (EHR notes + patient messages).
- Traffic: ~1.2M tokens/day expected initially; peak concurrent requests around 120 req/s during daytime windows.
- Key constraints: BAA required, SOC 2 Type II evidence, strict logging and audit requirements, and regional data residency for some customers.

Deployment mode options discussed:
- Hosted API: fastest to integrate; acceptable only if BAA + SOC2 + controls meet Elara legal & security bar; shared infrastructure but strong logical isolation and KMS integration.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools with tenant isolation; lower blast radius and predictable throughput (good fit if you need guaranteed performance and easier capacity planning).
- Private VPC / On-prem: for customers with strict audit/network requirements or on-prem/Kubernetes-only policy; longer lead time and higher setup effort.

Immediate asks from your side:
1) Confirm if PHI will be stored/persisted by Redwood or if Elara will enforce no-persist calls (we discussed both patterns).
2) Provide list of required controls beyond SOC2/BAA (e.g., specific encryption at rest KMS, HSM, MFA requirements, audit log retention window).

Action items (ours):
- I attached our redacted SOC2 Type II report and a draft BAA for your legal/security review.
- Marissa (SE) will map the control questions and provide clarifications on encryption, KM integration, and logging retention.
- Rishi (Security) will be available for a short call if Elara security team wants to deep-dive technical controls.

Proposed next steps:
- You review the SOC2 + BAA and Elara security questionnaire.
- If controls are acceptable, schedule a Dedicated-capacity demo (we think Dedicated is the right first recommendation) next week (May 14–15).
- If legal requires on-prem/VPC, we can scope Private deployment but timeline will be 8–12 weeks.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a proposed demo slot and the action items above.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Deployment mode & HIPAA requirements

Thanks, Dylan — helpful recap. A few clarifications from Elara side:

- PHI: yes, the workflows will touch PHI. Our default requirement is a signed BAA and SOC 2 Type II evidence for any vendor processing PHI. We also need to understand data residency: some of our customers require data to remain within the US.
- Persistence: in most flows we persist derived summaries into our EHR; we will prefer the no-persist API for raw ingestion but need options for both.
- Controls we need details on now: key management (do you support customer-managed keys / KMS?), encryption at rest specifics, detailed audit/logging (who accessed what and when), and incident response timelines.

I've attached our security questionnaire with a set of additional controls. Legal will want the BAA redline; happy to take your draft and mark it up.

Would like to see the Dedicated capacity demo if Dedicated is recommended — predictable performance is important for our SLAs. If Redwood’s SOC2 + BAA satisfy legal, hosted API + Dedicated reserved capacity could be our preference. If not, we’ll ask for Private VPC.

Can we plan a short follow-up on Wed (May 14) 10:00 AM PT for the Dedicated demo?

Best,
Amy Chen
Director, Platform Security
Elara Health

Subject: Fwd: Deployment mode & HIPAA requirements — internal notes

Looping in internal owners — quick notes to prep for Amy’s follow-up:

- Recommendation: Lead with Dedicated capacity + Hosted API endpoint (Dedicated offers reserved capacity and tenant isolation; customers get performance guarantees and we can still sign a BAA). This minimizes time-to-value relative to Private VPC while addressing Elara’s performance & isolation needs.
- If Elara legal pushes for Customer-Managed Keys and network restrictions beyond what Dedicated supports, escalate to Private VPC scoping. Private will require infra + account ops + legal — estimate 8–12 weeks.
- Rishi: can you prepare short bullets on KMS support (AWS CMEK support, HSM options), encryption at rest, and our logging/audit retention SLA? Also include whether we can provide redacted S3/object logs for audit.
- Action: Send SOC2 + BAA to Elara, set up Dedicated demo for May 14 10:00 AM PT (pending their confirmation), and schedule a 30-min technical deep-dive with Elara security if needed.

Marissa
